name: What is the difference between standard drywall, moisture-resistant board, and fire-rated sheetrock?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between standard drywall, moisture-resistant board, and fire-rated sheetrock?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard drywall works well for everyday living areas and bedrooms, but specialty boards are necessary for specific spaces. Moisture-resistant green board or cement backer board is essential in bathrooms, laundry rooms, and basement areas to prevent moisture absorption behind tile or paint. Fire-rated Type X drywall is thicker and required along shared garage walls and utility rooms to meet building safety standards. Sound-dampening drywall is another option for home theaters or shared bedroom partitions, balancing acoustic comfort with practical framing budgets.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard drywall suits dry living areas, moisture-resistant boards protect damp spaces like bathrooms, and thicker Type X drywall provides fire resistance for garages.
